summary: PulseGuard v0.6.9 improves package reliability, reduces unnecessary installation files, and keeps existing diagnostics, repair, optimization, reporting, and update behavior intact.

sections.heading: Package reliability
sections.detail: The customer release package is smaller and contains only the files required for normal PulseGuard operation and update compatibility.

sections.heading: Updater hardening
sections.detail: Release-package validation is stricter so unexpected or stale files cannot be introduced accidentally during future updates.

sections.heading: General maintenance
sections.detail: Removed unnecessary legacy packaging artifacts and performed general maintenance without changing existing diagnostics, repair, reporting, or Hardware Health behavior.
